Hi Jenna / Marissa —

Thanks for sending this over. A couple of quick questions so we can scope redlines efficiently:

1) If Acme has a preferred MSA template, please attach it. If not, we'll proceed from Redwood's standard MSA and track any counterparty asks.
2) Confirm whether data residency or residency carveouts are required (countries/regions). That affects exhibit selection.
3) Provide any previous security / SOC2 evidence or an existing security questionnaire we should reference — helps avoid back-and-forth.
4) Tell us which clauses are "blocking" (must-have) vs "negotiable" (nice-to-have). Example: indemnity/immunity, data processing terms, liability cap.

Once we have the party sheet and any counterparty template, typical turnaround for an initial marked draft is 2–3 business days. If Acme needs an accelerated path (sign within a week), flag which items you'd like canonical (e.g., we accept PO after signature).

Marissa — if you can push the party sheet into the thread I'll triage and start a redline matrix.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
